descriptionChirho: A report, piece of news, or tidings that is heard and circulates; the general sense of information received or spreading, whether true or uncertain (rumor).
A purposeful communication or authoritative announcement, especially a prophetic message or divine report delivered to an audience (as in Isaiah 53:1 'Who has believed our report?').
What is heard about a person or thing, their fame or renown; the report or account that establishes one's public reputation.
